PLAN "12-Week General Fitness for Post-MI Client (Moderate Intensity)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve functional strength and cardiovascular fitness within moderate intensity limits"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro to safe movement":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          seated_row 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Stability and light conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mobility and cadence":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks) cont:
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression and form":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Stability focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Cadence and breath control":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive loading within safe limits":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Motor control and tempo":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Balanced cardio steps":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks) cont:
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Technique and light cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Cardio intervals within zone":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Active recovery and mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names — no variants, no plurals):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES (use ONLY these names for warmups, cooldowns, and cardio sessions):
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking
